name: Melilot Brandybuck
subtitle: Merry Dancer
game_text: <phase>Response</phase>: If a burden is about to be added by a Shadow card, exert Melilot to prevent that burden.
flavor_text: “Master Everard Took and Miss Melilot Brandybuck got on a table and with bells in their hands began to dance the Springle-ring: a pretty dance, but rather vigorous.”
